$comment: Overrides for the check suite. BRIEF.md §3: an override must be an explicit,
dated, one-line-reason allowance in a committed file — the same shape as a
deviation log in a working paper. Never a silenced rule.
A check may consult this file. No check may be disabled by it. An allowance
narrows one named violation on one named page; it cannot turn a check off,
and tests/lib/allowances.js fails the suite if an entry is malformed or if
it no longer matches anything (a stale deviation log is its own defect).
Fields: id, check, page, match, reason (one line), dated, addedBy.

allowances.reason: 'Independent is a word for a practice with apparatus behind it' — the section named 'The word we do not use' must say the word to disclaim it, and the sentence is affirmative in form so the negation rule cannot reach it.
